scenario: When someone registers for a Zoom webinar, look up the registrant in HubSpot by email and create or update the contact with webinar name, registration date, and UTM source, then add them to the event's static list.
rule_hooks: dedupe by email, UTM-to-source mapping

scenario: After a webinar ends, read the Zoom attendee report and update each Salesforce campaign member's status to Attended or No-Show, and set minutes watched on the lead record.
rule_hooks: attendance threshold minutes, campaign member status values

scenario: A booth staffer drops the trade-show badge-scan spreadsheet into Google Drive; create Salesforce leads for new people, attach existing contacts to the event campaign, and log the booth rep as lead owner.
rule_hooks: existing-contact match, booth rep territory assignment

scenario: When a contact unsubscribes in Mailchimp, find them in HubSpot and Salesforce and set email opt-out, and add the address to the suppression sheet used by the sales sequencing tool.
rule_hooks: consent precedence rules, suppression list policy

scenario: Pull new Facebook/LinkedIn lead-form submissions and create HubSpot contacts with campaign, ad set, and form ID, assigning lifecycle stage based on the form's offer type.
rule_hooks: offer-type to lifecycle-stage mapping

scenario: Each Monday, read last week's spend per campaign from Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads and update the matching rows in the marketing budget Google Sheet, flagging campaigns over their monthly cap in Slack.
rule_hooks: campaign naming convention, monthly budget caps

scenario: When an agency invoice arrives in the marketing@ Gmail inbox, create a bill in QuickBooks under the right vendor and expense class and log it on the campaign budget tracker sheet.
rule_hooks: vendor-to-expense-class mapping, approval thresholds

scenario: When a new row is added to the editorial calendar Google Sheet, create a matching Asana task with writer, due date, and content type, and keep the sheet's status column in sync as the task moves.
rule_hooks: content type to workflow template, status mapping

scenario: When a blog post is published in WordPress, add or update its row in the content inventory sheet with URL, publish date, persona, and funnel stage, and close the corresponding Trello card.
rule_hooks: persona and funnel-stage taxonomy

scenario: When a HubSpot contact crosses the MQL score threshold, create or update the Salesforce lead with score, last conversion, and original source, and post a heads-up in the regional sales Slack channel.
rule_hooks: MQL score threshold, region routing table

scenario: When sales changes a Salesforce lead status to Disqualified or Recycled, update the HubSpot contact's lifecycle stage and remove them from active nurture lists.
rule_hooks: disqualification reason to nurture track mapping

scenario: When a Salesforce opportunity is created, read the primary contact's HubSpot first-touch and last-touch campaigns and write them onto the opportunity's attribution fields.
rule_hooks: attribution model rules, touch lookback window

scenario: When an opportunity closes won, update the influenced revenue column for each touching campaign in the campaign ROI Google Sheet.
rule_hooks: multi-touch credit split rules

scenario: When a co-marketing partner shares a lead list in a shared Google Sheet, create HubSpot contacts tagged with partner name and Salesforce leads owned by the partner manager, skipping existing customers.
rule_hooks: partner agreement lead terms, customer exclusion

scenario: When the social team adds an influencer to the Airtable roster, create a HubSpot company/contact with handle, follower count, and contract status, and keep payment status in sync from Xero.
rule_hooks: influencer tier thresholds, contract status values

scenario: When someone requests a demo via a tagged Instagram or LinkedIn DM in the social inbox, create a HubSpot contact with the social channel as source and open a task for the SDR on duty.
rule_hooks: SDR on-call rotation, source picklist

scenario: When a sponsorship contract is completed in DocuSign, create the sponsor record in the events Airtable base with tier, booth size, and logo deadline, and add deliverable tasks in Monday.com.
rule_hooks: sponsorship tier deliverable checklist

scenario: When a speaker confirms via the speaker intake form, update the conference agenda sheet with session title, time slot, and bio, and create the session in the event platform.
rule_hooks: track and time-slot assignment rules

scenario: Match paid ticket orders from Eventbrite to Stripe payouts and record them as sales receipts in QuickBooks under the event's class, flagging refunds.
rule_hooks: ticket type to revenue account mapping

scenario: When a visitor submits the website newsletter form (Typeform), add them to the right Mailchimp audience with interest tags based on selected topics and double opt-in status by country.
rule_hooks: topic-to-tag mapping, country consent rules

scenario: Nightly, read accounts that became customers in Salesforce and move their contacts from the prospect Mailchimp audience to the customer audience, preserving opt-in status.
rule_hooks: account type definitions, audience membership rules

scenario: When a customer subscription is canceled in the billing system, update their HubSpot lifecycle to Former Customer and enroll them in the win-back list, unless they have an open support escalation in Zendesk.
rule_hooks: churn reason exclusions, open-ticket check

scenario: When a Delighted/Survey response comes in with an NPS of 6 or lower, set a 'do not market' hold on the HubSpot contact and note it on the Salesforce account.
rule_hooks: NPS score bands, hold duration

scenario: When a customer leaves a 5-star G2 review, match the reviewer to a Salesforce contact and add them to the advocacy candidates sheet with account ARR and CSM owner.
rule_hooks: advocacy eligibility criteria (ARR, tenure)

scenario: When a customer signs a logo/reference release in DocuSign, mark the Salesforce account as reference-approved with permitted uses and update the approved-logos sheet the web team uses.
rule_hooks: permitted-use categories, release expiry

scenario: When a Zendesk ticket is tagged with a feature-request tag that matches an upcoming launch, add the requester to the HubSpot launch-announcement list with the feature as a property.
rule_hooks: tag-to-launch mapping

scenario: When a product launch record in the Asana launch tracker reaches 'Approved', copy launch date, tier, and messaging owner into the marketing calendar sheet and create campaign records in HubSpot and Salesforce.
rule_hooks: launch tier to channel mix rules

scenario: When a new campaign is requested in the campaign registry sheet, generate its standardized campaign code, create the Salesforce campaign with parent hierarchy, and write back the Salesforce campaign ID.
rule_hooks: naming convention, campaign hierarchy rules

scenario: When a marketer builds a tracked link in the link builder form, record it in the UTM master sheet and attach it to the matching HubSpot campaign, rejecting nonstandard source/medium values.
rule_hooks: approved source/medium vocabulary

scenario: At month end, read freelance writers' logged hours from the Harvest/Toggl project and create bills in Xero per writer, tagging each line with the content project code.
rule_hooks: contracted rates, project code mapping

scenario: When a design asset is approved in the Frame.io/Asana review, copy it to the brand asset library folder with standardized naming and log its usage rights and expiry in the asset register sheet.
rule_hooks: asset naming convention, license expiry

scenario: When someone downloads a gated ebook, update the HubSpot contact's content-consumed property and persona score, and add the download as an activity on the Salesforce lead or contact.
rule_hooks: asset-to-persona scoring weights

scenario: When sales leadership updates the ABM target account sheet, flag those accounts in Salesforce and HubSpot with ABM tier and upload the domain list to the LinkedIn matched audience.
rule_hooks: ABM tier criteria, account match by domain

scenario: Weekly, import the intent-data export (Bombora/6sense CSV) and update Salesforce account intent topics and surge scores, alerting account owners in Slack when a target account surges.
rule_hooks: surge score threshold, topic relevance list

scenario: When an SDR books a meeting through Calendly from a campaign follow-up, log the meeting on the Salesforce lead, mark the campaign member as Meeting Booked, and update the SDR's tally in the pipeline sheet.
rule_hooks: campaign member status ladder, meeting qualification rules

scenario: When a regional field event is created in the events calendar, pull Salesforce contacts in that region matching target titles and add them as campaign members with status Invited, syncing the list to Outreach.
rule_hooks: region by postal code, title inclusion list

scenario: When a data deletion request arrives through the privacy form in Freshdesk, find the person in HubSpot, Mailchimp, Salesforce, and the event registration sheets, delete or anonymize them, and log completion on the ticket.
rule_hooks: retention exceptions, legal-basis rules

scenario: When an Intercom website chat collects an email and company size, create or update the HubSpot contact with conversation summary and route to sales if company size exceeds the threshold.
rule_hooks: company size threshold, chat qualification fields

scenario: When a podcast guest confirms in the guest-booking sheet, create or update their HubSpot contact with episode details, send a Google Calendar recording invite, and add the episode to the content calendar.
rule_hooks: recording slot availability, guest type classification

scenario: Nightly, take HubSpot contacts missing industry or employee count, pull firmographics from the enrichment tool (Clearbit/ZoomInfo), and update HubSpot and the linked Salesforce account without overwriting sales-entered values.
rule_hooks: field source-of-truth precedence

scenario: When the weekly Shopify discount-redemption export lands in Google Sheets, look up each redeeming email in HubSpot and set its 'Last Promo Code' and 'Promo Campaign' properties, then add the contact to the matching HubSpot campaign. Codes not in the registry get flagged in Slack.
rule_hooks: promo code to campaign mapping sheet

scenario: Each time Salesforce opportunities move to Closed Won, add the primary contact's email and company domain to the 'Customer Exclusions' sheet that feeds LinkedIn and Google Ads matched audiences. Remove rows for accounts whose contracts have lapsed.
rule_hooks: account status and contract end date

scenario: Before a sales summit, carry hotel requests (arrival and departure nights, room type) from the registration sheet into the hotel's rooming-list sheet and update rows whose dates changed. Email the hotel coordinator a summary of the changes.
rule_hooks: company-paid nights policy, room block cutoff date

scenario: When a DocuSign envelope for an event sponsorship reaches Completed, create the commitment line in the marketing budget sheet under the right quarter and event, and create a draft bill in QuickBooks for the first installment.
rule_hooks: payment schedule terms, budget category codes

scenario: New signups from the customer referral program form are created or updated as HubSpot contacts with 'Referred By' set. The referring customer's 'Referrals Count' is incremented, and the CSM is pinged in Slack.
rule_hooks: referrer must be active customer, self-referral exclusion

scenario: When the PR agency emails its daily coverage digest to the marketing inbox, parse each article (outlet, headline, URL, date, sentiment) into the coverage tracker sheet, skipping duplicates. Post top-tier hits to #press.
rule_hooks: outlet tier list, duplicate URL check

scenario: Sync journalist records from the PR database export into HubSpot 'Media' contacts: update outlet, beat, and title when they change, and archive contacts who left journalism.
rule_hooks: beat taxonomy mapping, departure flags

scenario: After a product webinar, read the Zoom Q&A export and match each asker to a Salesforce contact. Create a follow-up task for the account owner that contains the question text, and leave questions from unmatched attendees for marketing.
rule_hooks: question category routing, existing open opportunity

scenario: Approved swag requests from the Google Form (recipient, address, kit type) are carried into the fulfillment vendor's order sheet. The inventory sheet is decremented, and the requester is emailed the order ID.
rule_hooks: kit stock levels, per-rep quarterly swag budget

scenario: When the direct-mail vendor emails its send confirmation CSV, mark the matching Salesforce campaign members as 'Mailed' with the ship date. Mark returned or undeliverable addresses 'Bad Address' and update the contact's mailing-address status.
rule_hooks: vendor delivery status codes

scenario: Opt-ins from the SMS platform's keyword report are written to HubSpot contacts as SMS consent fields (status, keyword, timestamp, source), and new contacts are created where needed. STOP replies flip consent off.
rule_hooks: keyword to subscription type, country consent rules

scenario: For new HubSpot leads, map the free-text 'How did you hear about us?' answer to the standardized Lead Source and Lead Source Detail fields. Unmapped answers are collected in a review sheet.
rule_hooks: lead source mapping table, don't overwrite existing source

scenario: New free-trial accounts from the product's daily signup sheet are created or updated in HubSpot with lifecycle stage 'Trial', plan, and trial end date, then enrolled in the onboarding list for their segment.
rule_hooks: company size segment, existing customer exclusion

scenario: Post-event Typeform responses update attendee records in HubSpot (session rating, topics of interest, 'wants demo'). Any respondent who checked 'wants demo' gets a task for the account owner.
rule_hooks: interest checkbox to property mapping, rating thresholds

scenario: Approved spend requests on the Asana marketing ops board become committed rows in the quarterly budget sheet, and a purchase order is created in QuickBooks. The requester is notified in Slack with the PO number.
rule_hooks: approval thresholds by amount, GL code by category

scenario: When a content item on the Asana board is tagged 'Ready for localization', add one row per target language to the translation vendor's tracker sheet. When the vendor marks a row delivered, sync its status back to the board.
rule_hooks: target languages by asset type and region

scenario: Guest blog pitches arriving in the content inbox are logged in the Airtable editorial pipeline (author, site, topic, proposed title). Off-topic or low-authority pitches are marked 'Declined' and get a polite reply.
rule_hooks: content pillar list, minimum domain authority

scenario: Replies to link-building outreach emails in Gmail update the matching row in the SEO outreach sheet: Agreed, Declined, Wants Payment, or Link Live with URL. A follow-up date is set for prospects with no reply.
rule_hooks: reply status classification, follow-up cadence

scenario: When the G2 review export shows newly published reviews from the incentive campaign, add the reviewers to the gift-card fulfillment sheet and set 'G2 Reviewer' on their HubSpot contacts.
rule_hooks: one incentive per reviewer, published status only

scenario: Once ad creatives are approved in Asana, carry each asset's file link, headline, CTA, and landing URL into the ad trafficking sheet, with one row per placement. Ad ops is notified in Slack.
rule_hooks: channel creative specs, placement matrix

scenario: Nightly, read LinkedIn and Google Ads campaign status, start and end dates, and budgets, then update the matching Salesforce campaign records. Ad campaigns without a Salesforce counterpart are flagged.
rule_hooks: campaign ID cross-reference, status mapping

scenario: Weekly, pull Salesforce opportunities that reached SQL or Closed Won and carry a stored GCLID, and add them to the Google Ads offline-conversion upload sheet with conversion name, value, and timestamp.
rule_hooks: conversion value by stage, 90-day click lookback

scenario: When the trade show staffing sheet is finalized, create Google Calendar shift invites for each assigned rep with booth location details, update invites when shifts change, and post the roster in the event channel.
rule_hooks: minimum coverage per shift, max hours per person

scenario: From a signed venue contract summary in Google Sheets, create Asana tasks for each deposit, headcount guarantee, and cancellation-window date, and create scheduled bills in Xero for each deposit.
rule_hooks: contract payment schedule, attrition clause dates

scenario: CSM nominations for the Customer Advisory Board, submitted via Slack workflow, are added to the CAB roster sheet after the account is checked in Salesforce. Accepted members get a CAB flag on their contact record.
rule_hooks: ARR tier minimum, one member per account, region balance

scenario: When account owners request comp passes for the user conference in a sheet, generate entries in the registration platform's comp list and log the code on the Salesforce contact. Requests that exceed the account's allocation are rejected.
rule_hooks: comp allocation by account tier and partner level

scenario: When a new version of a sales one-pager is approved in Google Drive, update the enablement library sheet with the new link and version, mark the prior version retired, and announce the change in #sales-enablement.
rule_hooks: versioning convention, retire superseded assets

scenario: Competitor intel posted in the #compete Slack channel is logged to the competitive tracker sheet under the right competitor, with source, claim, and date. The battlecard owner's Asana task is updated when a new pricing or feature claim appears.
rule_hooks: competitor alias list, claim type categories

scenario: Daily hard-bounce and spam-complaint reports from Mailchimp set the HubSpot contact's email status to invalid. Contacts at active opportunities get a task asking the owner for an updated address.
rule_hooks: bounce type classification, open opportunity check

scenario: When the job-change alert sheet lists a former customer champion at a new company, create or update the contact under the new Salesforce account. Tag the contact 'Former Champion' and notify the new account's owner.
rule_hooks: target account list match, prior customer status

scenario: After RevOps updates the territory map sheet, reassign open HubSpot leads and marketing contacts to the new owner by state and company size. Each rep is emailed a list of the leads they gained.
rule_hooks: territory map, exclude leads with active sequences

scenario: Negative brand mentions flagged in the social listening export become Zendesk tickets that link back to the post, with the author's handle and an urgency level. The social team logs the ticket number back in the listening sheet.
rule_hooks: sentiment and reach severity matrix, existing customer match

scenario: When a customer replies granting permission to reuse their photo or post, record the grant in the UGC rights log (scope, channels, expiry) and update the asset's tags in the DAM sheet so it shows as cleared.
rule_hooks: permitted usage scope, rights expiry date

scenario: The monthly affiliate network conversion report is reconciled into the payouts sheet. Commission is computed per partner, refunded orders are removed, and a vendor bill is created in QuickBooks for each payable affiliate.
rule_hooks: commission tiers, refund clawback window, minimum payout

scenario: When a Zoom webinar recording becomes available, add it to the on-demand content library sheet (title, speakers, topic, gated or ungated), and update the HubSpot campaign with the recording link for follow-up emails.
rule_hooks: gating rules by content type, topic taxonomy

scenario: Dietary and accessibility answers from the event registration sheet are aggregated into the caterer's headcount sheet by meal category. Individual accessibility requests are added to the venue coordinator's checklist.
rule_hooks: meal category mapping, catering final-count deadline

scenario: Partner market-development-fund claims submitted via form, with proof-of-performance attachments, are logged in the MDF ledger against each partner's allocation. Approved claims become bills in QuickBooks.
rule_hooks: partner MDF caps, eligible activity types, claim deadline

scenario: Monthly, find HubSpot contacts with no email engagement or site visits in 12 months and set them to non-marketing status, unless they belong to open opportunities or customer accounts. Log the changes in a sheet.
rule_hooks: inactivity threshold, protected segments

scenario: When subscribers change their topic preferences (product updates, events, blog digest) in the preference center, update the matching HubSpot subscription properties and add or remove them from the corresponding Mailchimp audience tags.
rule_hooks: topic to list mapping, global unsubscribe precedence

scenario: Contest entries from the social giveaway form are deduplicated into the entries sheet, with ineligible entrants marked. Drawn winners are logged on their HubSpot contacts and added to the prize fulfillment sheet.
rule_hooks: official rules eligibility (age, country, one entry per person)
